'''Jordan Hill''' (born July 27, 1987 in {{city-state|Atlanta|Georgia}}) is a [[college basketball]] [[Forward (basketball)|forward]] for the [[Arizona Wildcats men's basketball|Arizona Wildcats]]. He is considered one of the top prospects for the [[2009 NBA Draft]].<ref>[http://www.draftexpress.com/profile/Jordan-Hill-1222/ Draftexpress]</ref>
